tha-ap459:1.1: pathavī kukkuḷānugatā → paṭhavī kukkulānugatā (bj); puthuvī kukkulānugatā (pts) | pathavī → paṭhavī (sya-all) | paṭhavī → pathavī (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap459:3.1: marīciyotthaṭā → marīcimophunā (sya-all); marīcivophuṭā (pts) | marīciyotthaṭā → marīcivophutā (bj: syā); marīcivophuṭā (bj: PTS) | Marīciyotthaṭā → maricimophunā (cck: syā.); marīcivophuṭā (cck: pī.) | Marīcivophuṭā → G. marici mophutā; S2 marici voputā. (pts note)
tha-ap459:3.3: upahanti → upavāyanti (bj, pts); upaṭṭhanti (sya-all) | upavāyanti → upahanti (bj: machasaṁ) | Upahanti → upavāyanti (cck: sī. pī.) | upavāyanti → S2 upacāyanti; G. upahanti. (pts note)
tha-ap459:3.4: sarīrassāsukhepanā → sarīrakāyukhepanā (sya-all); sarīrass ānukhepanā (pts) | sarīrassāsukhepanā → sarīrakāyukhopana (bj: syā) | sarīrassāsukhepanā → sarīrakāyukhepanā (cck: syā.) | ānukhepanā → G. āyukhepanā; S1 āsukhepanā. (pts note)
tha-ap459:4.1: vihanantaṁ → vihanati (sya-all) | vihanantaṁ → vihanti (bj: syā) | vihanantaṁ → vihanati (cck: syā. ka.) | viharanti → S1 vihaṇāti; G. vihanati. (pts note)
tha-ap459:4.4: phassayissāmi → passayissāmi (cck: ka.) | phassayissāmi → G. phassassissāmi; S1 passayissāmi. (pts note)
tha-ap459:5.2: mahāyaso mama saṅkappamaññāya paṭiggaṇhi → mahāisi mamasaṅkappamaññāya paṭigaṇhi (bj) | mahāisi → mahāyaso (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap459:7.2: asaṅkhiyaṁ → asaṅkhayaṁ (sya-all) | gaṇanāto → gaṇahāto (pts) | gaṇahāto → G. S1 gaṇanātho. (pts note)
tha-ap459:8.4: dharīyati satasahassito → dhariyyati satasahasse ito (pts) | dhariyyati → G. dharissati. (pts note)
